name: A.P.C. Golf
city: Paris (A.P.C.); golf line developed in Seoul by licensee IDLOOK
founded: A.P.C. 1987 (UNVERIFIED this session); golf line launched in Korea and Japan in 2021 per apc-us.com (Hypebeast dates the first collection SS22)
why_quiet: A.P.C.'s minimal Paris DNA applied to golf: neutral palette anchored by navy/indigo, ribbed knits, contrast tipping, pleated wide trousers; the brand pitches 'no overly technical gear — just pure elegance'. Caveat: every piece carries a small embroidered 'A.P.C. golf' script logo (tonal on the sweater vest), and prices are high ($270-$610).

quote.text: I don't like the way that amateur players try to dress like professional golfers. I just want them to be chic.
quote.who: Jean Touitou, A.P.C. founder (as quoted by Hypebeast)

facts.fact: A.P.C. US site: after launching in Korea and Japan in 2021, the golf line is now available beyond Asia; 'no overly technical gear — just pure elegance'.
A.P.C. GOLF is developed by Korean company IDLOOK (FW25 'A.P.C. GOLF CLUB' campaign).
Reached US and European shoppers for FW25; Skratch called it 'casual elegance' vs golf's louder prints and branding.
Hypebeast: SS23 line arranged in neutral colors with A.P.C.'s signature indigo as anchor; contrast tipping and trims throughout.
SS26 capsule with LPGA player Ko Jin-young (Korea).
Superfuture reports golf is a favourite sport of Touitou's (UNVERIFIED - from search summary only).

picks.desc: - Off-white short-sleeved polo shirt. - Ribbed polo collar. - Tonally matched two-button fastening. - Sleeves with contrasting stripes. - Wide ribbed band at the hem. - "A.P.C. golf" logo embroidered on the chest. - Relaxed fit.

- Knitted sleeveless sweater. - Ribbed V-neck. - Lightweight cotton-blend knit. - Ribbed finishes at the armholes and hem. - Tonally matched "A.P.C. golf" logo embroidered on the chest. - Contrasting ivory details.

- Navy blue golf trousers inspired by the Renato style, with a wide fit. - Made from water-repellent fabric with slight stretch for enhanced comfort. - Wide fit with a front pleat for a relaxed silhouette. - Structured waistband with belt loops and D-ring. - Two side pockets and two back flap pockets. - Front zip and button fastening. - Vintage "A.P.C. golf" logo embroidered on the front.

- Navy blue zip-up jacket with stand collar. - Hybrid design combining the warmth of down with the flexibility of a cardigan. - Windproof lining throughout the body and sleeves. - High wraparound collar for optimal protection. - Two side welt pockets with contrasting details. - Ribbed cuffs and hem. - "A.P.C. golf" logo embroidered on the chest.

- Cream long-sleeved windbreaker. - Water-repellent and water-resistant fabric for everyday use. - Removable sleeves allowing the garment to be worn as either a short- or long-sleeved style. - Integrated hood with drawstrings to adapt to changing temperatures. - Contrasting ecru panels on the shoulders and upper sleeves. - Front zip fastening. - Two side pockets. - Elasticated cuffs. - Drawstring

- Burgundy cardigan with contrasting ecru trims. - V-neckline. - Button fastening at the front. - Two front patch pockets with contrasting trims. - "apc golf" logo embroidered on the pocket. - Ribbed cuffs and hem.
